title: DGES Portugal Government Scholarship (Study Grant) 2026/2027
provider: Direção-Geral do Ensino Superior (DGES) / Portuguese Government
eligibility_summary: Students with limited financial resources enrolled in Portuguese higher education institutions. Open to Portuguese citizens, EU nationals with permanent residence, third-country nationals with permanent residence permits, long-term residents, stateless persons, and political refugees. Must meet academic success requirements.
funding_details: Monthly stipend paid in up to 10 installments per academic year. Amount calculated based on household income and academic merit. May cover tuition fees partially or fully. Late applications (after Oct 2) receive prorated amounts.
notes: Applications for 2026/2027 are currently OPEN. Applications must be submitted exclusively online through the BeOn platform. Students already enrolled: apply between Aug 14 and Oct 2, 2026. New students: apply within 20 working days of enrollment if after Oct 2, or between Oct 3, 2026 and May 31, 2027 for prorated amounts.

title: FCT PhD Studentships 2026 – Regular Line of Application
provider: Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (FCT)
funding_type: Full research fellowship (stipend + tuition + travel + insurance)
eligibility_summary: Applicants enrolled or eligible to enroll in a PhD program. Open to Portuguese, EU, third-country nationals, stateless persons, and political refugees. Must not have previously received an FCT PhD studentship or hold a doctoral degree. Must live in Portugal if applying for studentship in Portugal or both in Portugal and abroad.
funding_details: Monthly maintenance allowance per FCT RBI regulations. Includes tuition fees, support for complementary training, travel to scientific meetings, personal accident insurance, and where applicable, installation and travel/relocation costs. Funded by State Budget and European Social Fund (PESSOAS 2030).
notes: 2026 call CLOSED. Provisional results announced July 31, 2026. Final results expected November 2026. 1,600 studentships awarded (1,000 general + 600 non-academic). Studentships start between Sep 1, 2026 and Aug 1, 2027. Next 2027 call expected March 2027.

title: FCT PhD Studentships 2026 – Specific Line (Non-Academic Environment)
provider: Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (FCT)
funding_type: Full research fellowship (stipend + tuition + travel + insurance)
eligibility_summary: PhD candidates whose research plan is primarily carried out in non-academic institutions (business companies, public administration, social/health/cultural organizations). Must ensure at least 12 months in the same non-academic host institution in Portugal. Must also have a national or foreign academic host institution.
funding_details: Same as regular line: monthly allowance, tuition fees, training support, travel to conferences, personal accident insurance, and where applicable, installation and relocation costs. 600 studentships specifically allocated for non-academic environment. Total funding €54.375 million.
notes: 2026 call CLOSED. Provisional results announced July 31, 2026. Final results expected November 2026. Part of same FCT PhD competition as regular line. Expressions of interest permanently open to non-academic entities wishing to host doctoral students.

title: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2026 (with Portugal as host)
provider: European Commission – Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions / FCT (Portugal)
funding_type: Full fellowship (living allowance + mobility allowance + research costs)
eligibility_summary: Researchers with a PhD (or who will have defended their thesis by the deadline). Must not have resided or carried out main activity in the host country for more than 12 months in the 36 months before the deadline. Must not have completed PhD more than 8 years before deadline (with exceptions). Portugal qualifies for ERA Fellowships under Widening activities.
funding_details: Living allowance (country coefficient 94.6% for Portugal), mobility allowance, research costs, and complementary funding. European Fellowships: research in EU/associated country. Global Fellowships: outgoing phase to third country + return to Europe. ERA Fellowships option available for Portugal-hosted projects. Expected to fund ~1,600 projects EU-wide.
notes: Applications OPEN until September 9, 2026. FCT held an information session on May 25, 2026. Project start dates between April 1, 2027 and September 1, 2028. Submit via Funding and Tenders Opportunities Portal (HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01).

title: Camões I.P. – Scholarship Program for Annual Courses in Portuguese Language and Culture 2026
provider: Camões – Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua, I.P. (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
eligibility_summary: International students interested in attending annual Portuguese language and culture courses at Portuguese universities (Aveiro, Coimbra, Lisbon, Minho, Nova University Lisbon, Porto). Must enroll in the annual course on the university platform before applying.
funding_details: Monthly stipend defined by Camões Board of Directors. Covers tuition fees, personal accident insurance, and where applicable, travel and installation costs. Co-financed by State Budget and Empresa Promotora da Língua Portuguesa (EPLP). 14 scholarships available.
notes: 2026 call CLOSED (May 5-18, 2026). Results announced; scholarships for school year 2026/2027. Next cycle expected May 2027 for 2027/2028. Application via Portal de Serviços do Camões.

title: Camões I.P. – Summer Course Scholarship Program 2026 (Online and In-Person)
provider: Camões – Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua, I.P. (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
eligibility_summary: International students interested in attending 4-week summer courses in Portuguese language and culture at Portuguese universities (Aveiro, Coimbra/FLUC, Lisbon/FLUL, Minho, Nova/ FCSH, Porto/FLUP). Priority given to consortium university courses.
funding_details: 10 scholarships for in-person courses, 58 scholarships for online courses. Covers tuition fees and provides monthly stipend. Funded by Camões State Budget and EPLP. Courses run from June 29 to July 24, 2026.
notes: 2026 call CLOSED (May 5-18, 2026). Next cycle expected May 2027 for Summer 2027.

title: Camões I.P. – Research Scholarship Program 2026
provider: Camões – Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua, I.P. (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
eligibility_summary: Researchers of any nationality proposing research projects related to Portuguese language, culture, or cooperation with Portuguese-speaking countries. Must have a research proposal aligned with Camões priorities.
funding_details: Monthly stipend defined by Camões Board of Directors. 13 scholarships available. Funded by Camões State Budget and EPLP. Research must begin September 2026 onwards.
notes: 2026 call CLOSED (May 5-18, 2026). Next cycle expected May 2027.

title: Camões I.P. – Fernão Mendes Pinto Scholarship Program 2026
provider: Camões – Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua, I.P. (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
funding_type: Fully funded scholarship (tuition + stipend + travel + insurance)
eligibility_summary: International students from Portuguese-speaking countries (CPLP) and other countries admitted to undergraduate, master's, or doctoral programs at Portuguese universities. Priority given to CPLP nationals.
funding_details: Monthly stipend, tuition fee coverage, travel and installation support, personal accident insurance, and health insurance. 18 scholarships available. Funded by Camões State Budget and EPLP.
duration: Duration of the degree program (up to PhD level)
notes: 2026 call CLOSED (May 5-18, 2026). Next cycle expected May 2027.

title: University of Coimbra Merit Scholarships for International Students
application_deadline: Varies by admission cycle (ongoing for enrolled students)
eligibility_summary: International students (non-EU/EEA) admitted to UC through Special Contest for International Students or institution/course change contest. Must hold International Student Status. Must have admission grade ≥ 14/20 (Bachelor's/Integrated Master's) or ≥ 15/20 (Master's). For Bachelor's: admission grade determines tier. For Master's: €2,000 tuition support, plus additional €1,000 for CPLP students, plus €1,000 continuing studies scholarship.
funding_details: Bachelor's/Integrated Master's: tuition fee discount ranging from €1,000 to €2,000 based on admission grade (14-17 scale). Master's: €2,000 annual tuition support (renewable). CPLP students: additional €1,000. Continuing studies: additional €1,000. Priority courses may offer €2,000 for admission grade ≥ 13.
duration: Duration of the study cycle (renewable annually for Master's)
notes: Regulation No. 346/2025 in force for 2025/2026 onward. Does not apply to International Medicine. Applications tied to UC admission process.

title: University of Aveiro Incentive Scholarships for International Students 2026/2027
eligibility_summary: International students admitted to 1st or 2nd cycle programs. Three categories: (a) merit attraction for 1st cycle (full-time, admission grade ≥ 14/20); (b) merit attraction for 2nd cycle (full-time, admission grade ≥ 14/20); (c) strategic interest (full-time, admission grade ≥ 14/20, for specific strategic programs including CPLP priority and Latin American partnerships).
funding_details: Scholarship equals the difference between international tuition fee and €1,000 (or €1,000 flat for 1st cycle merit attraction). For 2026/2027, 1st cycle merit attraction requires admission grade ≥ 16/20 for full tuition coverage down to €1,000.
duration: 1 academic year (renewable according to academic performance)
notes: Based on Regulation No. 950/2021 and Despacho REIT/2026. 2025/2026 criteria published; 2026/2027 criteria expected before admission cycles. Applications via UA international admission process.

title: Nova SBE Merit Scholarship (Master's Programs)
provider: Nova School of Business and Economics (Nova SBE) – Universidade NOVA de Lisboa
eligibility_summary: All candidates admitted to Nova SBE Master's programs, regardless of nationality. Awarded based on academic excellence (GPA) from undergraduate degree. Automatic consideration for merit scholarship when applying for admission.
funding_details: Tuition fee coverage of 20%, 50%, or 100% depending on GPA tier. No separate application required for base merit scholarship; considered automatically with admission application.
duration: Duration of the Master's program (typically 1-2 years)
notes: Rolling basis until budget exhausted. For 2025/26 academic year applications open Nov 13, 2025 – Mar 23, 2026. 2026/27 cycle expected similar timeline.

title: ULisboa PhD Scholarships under Unite! Widening – Industry-Embedded Doctoral School
provider: University of Lisbon (ULisboa) – Unite! Widening Project
eligibility_summary: Students holding a Master's degree in Science and Technology, enrolled in a PhD program, integrated into ULisboa educational project. Must involve collaboration with an industrial partner (min. 3 months) and academic co-supervision from a Unite! Alliance university in a non-Widening country (min. 6 months). Preference for candidates meeting strategic criteria.
funding_details: Monthly stipend of €1,810.00. Covers annual tuition fees, costs associated with industrial placement, and stay at academic partner in non-Widening country. Up to 7 scholarships available. Renewable up to maximum 36 months until Dec 31, 2028.
notes: 2025 call CLOSED (June 20 – July 26, 2025). Scholarships started Oct 1, 2025. Future cycles dependent on project continuation.

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters – Programs with Portuguese Universities (2027/2028 cycle)
provider: European Commission (Erasmus+) – Various consortia including Portuguese universities
eligibility_summary: Students from all countries with a bachelor's degree (or in final year). Must meet mobility requirements (max 12 months in EU/Programme country in previous 5 years for Partner Country students). Must complete mandatory mobility in at least 2 different countries. Portugal-based EMJM programs for 2027 include: EMSEX (Sexology, Portugal-coordinated), ReAnima (Animation, Portugal partner), CYBER (Cyberspace and e-Therapy, Portugal partner), WAVES Plus (Engineering and Sound, Portugal partner), MINDER (Nuclear Decommissioning, U.Porto coordinated), M-FLEET (Logistics and Transportation, U.Porto partner).
funding_details: Full tuition waiver, €1,400/month living allowance (up to 24 months), travel contribution (€1,000/year for Programme Country, €2,000-3,000/year for Partner Country based on distance), €1,000 installation contribution (Partner Country only), health insurance. Total value ~€42,000-56,000 over 24 months.
notes: 2026/2027 cycle applications mostly closed. 37 new programs selected July 16, 2026 for 2027/2028 intake. Applications expected to open autumn 2026. Check official Erasmus Mundus Catalogue for exact program-specific deadlines. Portugal involved in multiple consortia (U.Porto, ULisboa, UA, etc.).

title: FCT Scientific Employment Stimulus – Individual Call (8th Edition)
provider: Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (FCT)
eligibility_summary: PhD holders of any nationality in any scientific area wishing to develop research in Portugal. Two categories: (1) Junior Researcher – PhD for 5 years or less; (2) Assistant Researcher – PhD holders with relevant curriculum. Must not hold incompatible positions.
funding_details: Full salary funded by FCT: Junior Researcher at level 33 of single remuneration scale; Assistant Researcher at 1st step of assistant researcher career (per Decree Law 55/2025). Contract up to 3 years (can be used over 6 years with suspensions). Co-financed by national funds and EU funds where eligible.
notes: 8th edition CLOSED (Dec 15, 2025 – Feb 2, 2026). Final results announced June 17, 2026. Next edition expected late 2026 or early 2027.

title: University of Porto Merit Scholarships
eligibility_summary: U.Porto students with exceptional academic achievement in Bachelor's, Master's, or Integrated Master's programs. Awarded annually to students with the best academic results, regardless of socio-economic situation.
funding_details: Cash prize amount varies by faculty and academic performance. Specific amounts defined in U.Porto General Regulation on Merit Scholarships. Additional SASUP study scholarships available for students with financial need (Portuguese/EU nationals, stateless persons, and nationals from cooperation protocol countries; International Student Status excluded).
duration: 1 academic year (renewable based on academic merit)
notes: Merit scholarships awarded annually. SASUP scholarships require separate application through Social Support Services (SASUP). International students with International Student Status should check individual faculty financial incentives.

title: Nova SBE – DGES Scholarship (Social Mobility)
provider: Universidade NOVA de Lisboa – SASNOVA / DGES
eligibility_summary: NOVA University Lisbon students (1st and 2nd cycle) with reduced financial abilities. Open to Portuguese citizens, EU nationals with permanent residence, third-country nationals with permanent residence/long-term resident status, stateless persons, and political refugees. Must meet academic success requirements and not hold a higher degree than the one applied for.
funding_details: Monthly stipend paid directly by DGES. Amount based on household income and academic merit. May cover tuition fees. Application via BeOn platform. Administered by SASNOVA.
notes: For 2026/2027, standard application period is August 14 to October 2, 2026. Students enrolling after Oct 2 have 20 working days to apply. Applications between Oct 3, 2026 and May 31, 2027 receive prorated amounts.

title: FCT PhD Studentships 2025 – Regular Line (Final Results)
provider: Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (FCT)
funding_type: Full research fellowship (stipend + tuition + travel + insurance)
eligibility_summary: Same as 2026 call: PhD candidates enrolled or eligible to enroll. Open to all nationalities. Must not have previous FCT PhD studentship or doctoral degree. Must live in Portugal for Portugal-based studentships.
funding_details: Monthly allowance, tuition fees, training support, conference travel, personal accident insurance, installation and relocation costs where applicable. 1,550 studentships awarded (including 550 non-academic). Total funding €85.8 million.
notes: 2025 call CLOSED. Final results announced November 13, 2025. Studentships started between Sep 1, 2025 and Aug 1, 2026. Reference for expected 2027 call structure.

title: MBUILD – Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Sustainable Built Environment (5th Edition, Self-Funded)
provider: Universidade do Porto (FEUP) – Erasmus Mundus Consortium
eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree in relevant field (Engineering, Architecture, etc.). English language proficiency required. International students from all countries. Note: 5th edition is NOT co-funded by Erasmus Mundus; all students are self-funded.
funding_details: Tuition fees only (no living allowance or travel support). EU students: €2,500/year. Non-EU students: €6,000/year. CPLP students: €3,300/year. Students must cover all travel, living, and participation costs.
notes: 5th edition (2026/2027) applications closed Jan 31, 2026. NOT co-funded by Erasmus Mundus this edition. Program starts early September 2026 at FEUP/Porto. Future editions may seek Erasmus Mundus funding again.

title: Portugal Government Scholarship – DGES Study Grant (2025/2026 Cycle – Late Applications)
provider: Direção-Geral do Ensino Superior (DGES) / Portuguese Government
eligibility_summary: Same as 2026/2027 cycle. For students already enrolled in 2025/2026 who did not apply during the main window (Jun 25 – Sep 30, 2025). Late applications accepted from Oct 1, 2025 to May 31, 2026 with prorated scholarship amounts.
funding_details: Prorated monthly stipend based on remaining academic period. Amount calculated from month following application submission to end of academic term.
notes: Main 2025/2026 application window closed Sep 30, 2025. Late applications accepted until May 31, 2026. This is a transitional program; 2026/2027 applications are now the priority.
